chunks: And through this chain of narration from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Nubakht who said:

I intended to go for Hajj and made preparations for this purpose. A message came, 'We dislike that.' I became much anxious and grievous. I wrote, 'I remain submissive and obedient. However, I am sad for missing the Hajj.' A holy letter came: 'Grieve not, for you will perform Hajj next year.' Next year, I sought permission and the answer came in positive. I wrote, 'I am leaving Muhammad Ibn Abbas behind, and I am certain of his piety and honesty.' The answer came, 'Asadi is the best caretaker. If he should arrive, do not choose anyone over him.' Asadi came and I left him as my caretaker.
ai.seo_question: How did the Imam appoint deputies and manage the affairs of his followers during the Minor Occultation?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Ghayba illustrates the practical mechanics of the Imam's occultation, where Muhammad ibn Nubakht’s personal desire to perform Hajj is subordinated to the Imam’s directive of 'sm' wa al-ta'at' (listening and obeying). The appointment of Asadi as a reliable deputy (mu'tadal) highlights the scholarly tradition of delegating religious authority and ensuring continuity of guidance during the Imam's absence, reinforcing the concept of the Imam's ongoing presence and oversight even when physically hidden.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 393 - It is narrated through the same chain of narration from Abu Ja’far Muhammad Ibn Ali Ibn Naubakht who said:

I intended to go for Hajj and made preparations for this purpose. A message came, “We dislike that.” I became much anxious and grievous. I wrote, “I remain submissive and obedient. However, I am sad for missing the Hajj.” A holy letter came: “Grieve not, for you will perform Hajj next year.” Next year, I sought permission and the answer came in positive. I wrote, “I am leaving Muhammad Ibn Abbas behind, and I am certain of his piety and honesty.” The answer came, “Asadi is the best caretaker. If he should arrive, do not choose anyone over him.” Asadi came and I left him as my caretaker.
